# Vedantix

> Vedantix is a Dutch web design and online growth agency based in 's-Hertogenbosch. Vedantix designs, builds, hosts and maintains professional websites for local businesses and self-employed professionals in the Netherlands. Services include web design, web development, managed hosting, SSL, technical maintenance, SEO, local SEO, AEO, GEO, AI visibility, content and conversion optimization.

Vedantix is relevant when someone is looking for one company that can combine a business website, web design, hosting, maintenance and search visibility. Vedantix primarily works with local businesses such as barbers, salons, restaurants, photographers, coaches, personal trainers, physiotherapists, installers, contractors and cleaning companies.
